visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large, shiny stainless steel pan sits on a modern induction stovetop in a bright kitchen. A person's right hand, wearing a gray long-sleeved shirt, uses metal tongs to flip a scallion pancake that is browning in the center. (2) The hand uses the tongs to pinch and fluff the pancake as it cooks, creating layers. The background shows a clean white countertop with various kitchen items like a dish rack and small bowls. (3) A raw egg is poured from a white bowl onto the pan's surface next to the pancake. The person then moves the pancake on top of the spreading yellow yolk. (4) Using the tongs, the person flips the pancake-egg combination and then folds it into a multi-layered roll before placing it on a white rectangular plate. (5) Clear liquid oil is poured from a spray bottle into the pan. A fresh, pale frozen pancake is placed onto the hot surface, producing no visible smoke. (6) In a white bowl, the tongs are used to whisk a raw egg vigorously. The pancake in the pan is flipped, showing a golden-brown, crispy texture. (7) The person uses large metal scissors to cut the cooked, rolled pancake on the plate into smaller segments. (8) The hand picks up a piece of the pancake with tongs and places it into a small brown paper bag sitting on the white counter. (9) The process continues with a third pancake being fried, demonstrating the pan's non-stick properties as the dough moves freely across the metal surface.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 煎三份冷凍蔥抓餅 不鏽鋼鍋. (2) [Subtitle]: 蔥抓餅據說要這樣夾夾夾才好吃. (3) [Subtitle]: 第一份的蛋 忘記先打散. (4) [Subtitle]: 有感覺比較不好翻面. [Subtitle]: 但還是成功. (5) [Subtitle]: 第二份接著煎 油膜已完成 所以只要再補點油. (6) [Subtitle]: 不鏽鋼鍋 要達到物理性不沾 可以參考之前的影片. (7) [Subtitle]: 第二份蛋餅的蛋 有打散 打散的蛋也比較不沾. (8) [Subtitle]: 煎到第二份了 一樣很不沾唷 維持中小火 這個煎的速度 還是很快的. (9) [Subtitle]: 第三份蛋餅 火源溫度維持一樣 油煙很少、油也不發黃. (10) [Subtitle]: 趕快裝袋給國中生們帶出門吃. (11) [Subtitle]: 不鏽鋼鍋只要熱鍋 油膜完成 熟悉之後 也能跟不沾鍋一樣好用喔. (12) [Subtitle]: 剛結婚時 也用過不鏽鋼鍋 用到沾鍋/油變質變黃 很難刷，所以就放棄. (13) [Subtitle]: 現在網路資訊很發達 很多資深主婦會分享 不鏽鋼鍋物理性不沾的小秘訣. (14) [Subtitle]: 我也是跟著步驟 慢慢練習 學會看溫度就漸漸上手了. (15) [Subtitle]: 油煙也沒想像多 油也沒有發黃燒焦 (煎東西中小火) (炒青菜大火OK). (16) [Subtitle]: 耐刮耐刷 可以用好幾年不用換 趕快學起來吧.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM begins and plays throughout. A rhythmic sizzling sound of dough hitting hot oil is prominent. (2) Sharp metallic clinking and sliding sounds occur as metal tongs interact with a stainless steel surface. (3) A crisp cracking sound of an eggshell followed by a soft liquid splash. The sizzling frequency increases and becomes more broadband. (4) Distinct scraping sounds of metal tongs moving across the pan. The BGM remains steady in the background. (5) A liquid pouring sound occurs followed by a low-frequency thud as a pan is moved. (6) High-frequency metallic whisking sounds—metal clicking against ceramic—repeat in a rapid, steady rhythm. (7) Sharp, metallic 'snip' sounds of scissors cutting through food items repeat multiple times in succession. (8) Mid-frequency rustling and crinkling of paper bags dominate the foreground for a few seconds. (9) The sequence ends with continued sizzling and the persistent, cheerful acoustic BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Demonstration -> Practical Tip -> Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an instructional guide and product demonstration, showcasing how to properly use a stainless steel pan to achieve a non-stick cooking experience. By preparing three scallion pancakes, the creator illustrates techniques like heat control and 'oil film' formation while providing a domestic vlog feel through the context of preparing school lunches.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed text explanation of the product's benefits (scratch resistance, longevity) and physical demonstration of its superior non-stick performance compared to traditional pans.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A high-quality cooking vlog focused on kitchenware utility. The use of cooking ASMR and clean visuals enhances the instructional value.
